text: Welcome to the Lake County Tech Campus Foundation website. Skills. Success. Future.

The Foundation was launched in July 2026 to expand opportunities for Lake County Tech Campus students across Lake and McHenry Counties. The home page leads with the mission: helping students turn hands-on training into careers, with real numbers from the Foundation's yearly report and a look at the programs your gifts support.

Giving starts on one simple Donate page. Every giving opportunity from the Foundation's campaign is on the page at once, each with its own price: a twenty-five dollar Career Expo registration, a fifty dollar safety certification, a five hundred dollar professional toolkit, all the way up to a ten thousand dollar innovation gift. Pick one, and choose how many with plus and minus. Donors can give once, monthly, or yearly, and dedicate a gift in honor or in memory of someone. Checkout is a demo for now, so no card is ever charged, and every gift lands in the admin dashboard.

The Programs page lists all eighteen Tech Campus programs, from welding and automotive to cybersecurity, nursing, and culinary arts. Each one has its own page explaining what students learn and where it leads.
Events bring donors, alumni, and students together. Every event has its own page with the date, location, and a one minute RSVP. Guests can add the event straight to their calendar.
The blog keeps supporters up to date with event recaps and Foundation news. Posts can be linked to an event, so the story shows up on that event's page too.
Meet the board shows the volunteer leaders guiding the Foundation, from business, industry, education, and the community. Each member has a profile page with their role and background.

Students can apply for aid in four short steps: about them, their request, their story, and a final review. They get a confirmation number right away, and can download a copy of their application as a PDF.
Alumni can join the network, share where they are now, and add a photo. Stories appear on the site after a quick review.

Behind it all is the admin dashboard. Staff sign in with their role: super admin, admin, accountant, or member. The dashboard shows the latest submissions and upcoming events at a glance. Donations, grant applications, messages, and RSVPs all arrive here, ready to search, filter, and export. Staff can also edit events, blog posts, programs, board members, and yearly reports, without a developer.
The Lake County Tech Campus Foundation. Give a student their start.
